title: hotbar pets
description: add a diamond, emerald, and amethyst hotbar pet
body: this mod adds 3 new things. a diamond hotbar pet a amethyst hotbar pet and a emerald hotbar pet. they do nothing but are really cute. the modpack is for serverside becouse it adds items. you can craft each by adding the item that is it made of so for diamond it is a diamond for emerald a emerald and for amethyst a amethyst. when you have the one you want to craft you suround it with sugar to get the hotbar pet.
